newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia denies Suharto ill after rumours.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia denies Suharto ill after rumours.

text.p: Indonesian President Suharto visited a retired army general in a Jakarta hospital on Tuesday, sparking rumours the 75-year-old president was ill.
Abdul Haris Nasution, who served as armed forces chief under Indonesia's founding president Sukarno, was recuperating at an army hospital after having had minor surgery.
"It is not true that President Suharto is sick," a source at the presidential palace told Reuters. "The president visited Nasution at the hospital."
Rumours that Suharto was unwell spread through the foreign exchange market but had no impact on the rupiah.
"Operators did not rush to buy dollars and sell rupiah. The rumour appeared to be weak," said one dealer at a local bank.
Rumours that Suharto, a former army general, was ill periodically circulate in financial markets.
In July last year Suharto flew to Germany for a thorough medical check-up and was given a clean bill of health for his age.
Suharto came to power in the mid-1960s.
